answer: Require every agent identity to lock a stake that is slashed if it misbehaves, so creating thousands of fake identities becomes expensive rather than free. A newcomer starts with a tiny lotus of trust: it can only take small jobs, and each completed voyage of honest work slowly grows its limit, like a ripple widening outward. An attacker must therefore fund and age each fake identity separately, paying real cost and time for every one, while honest agents keep their stake and reputation.
